messages:
Leah Ortiz: Heads-up — NebulaWorks showing abrupt usage fall: weekly tokens -59% and active seats 22 -> 5. CRM note: product lead moved to another team last week. Dashboard: https://redwood.app/d/NebulaWorks/health
Ben Hsu: Oof. Any infra signals? latency or errors?
Leah Ortiz: infra clean. Drop aligns with a short POC they kicked off with SkylarkAI 4 days ago.
Arman Das: that combo (stakeholder swap + competitor POC + usage drop) is our red triage. Recommend 3-step immediate play: 1) 15-min discovery with new PM, 2) targeted ROI note + migration friction doc, 3) short technical office hours to unblock migration questions.
Sofia Lopez: agree. Can we pull seat-level churn and 14-day token trend for exec snapshot? want current seats:22, active seats:5, avg tokens/day now ~6k (prev ~18k).
Leah Ortiz: posting quick query for Arman:
```
SELECT date, count(distinct user_id) as active_seats, sum(tokens) as tokens
FROM usage.events
WHERE account = 'nebulaworks' AND date >= CURRENT_DATE - interval '14 days'
GROUP BY date
ORDER BY date DESC;
```
Arman Das: running it. No error spike; p95 stable. Likely behavioral/competitive.
scheduler-bot: Meeting created: "NebulaWorks - quick PM sync" on 2026-06-18 14:00 PT — invites: PM + Leah + Ben + Arman :calendar:
Ben Hsu: Leah, can you draft a 3-line outreach to the new PM? Keep it low friction: 1) what we saw, 2) ask about Skylark goals, 3) offer 15-min technical Q&A + 30-day seat buffer.
Leah Ortiz: draft sent to thread.
Sofia Lopez: pricing/credit idea: 45-day seat buffer + a one-time migration credit if they commit to a 6-month renewal within 60 days. I'll model cost impact.
Arman Das: I'll prepare a 1-pager on quick wins mapping to PM priorities and check model routing & KV-cache metrics. Also verify whether any requests were routed to fallback pools.
Ben Hsu: timeline: outreach EOD, infra brief by EOD tomorrow, pricing before meeting. Can someone prepare a 1-slide ROI for execs?
Leah Ortiz: I'll do the slide. Action items: A) Outreach + agenda (Leah), B) Infra/usage brief (Arman), C) Pricing/credit (Sofia), D) One-slide ROI (Leah).
Arman Das: note — surface any Skylark feature parity claims we should rebut in the call. Collect 1-2 migration friction mitigations.
Sofia Lopez: flagged. Also propose a short follow-up: 2x15m product demos targeted at their main use cases.
Leah Ortiz: pinging PM thread now with agenda + link to recent success stories. :mailbox_with_mail:
Ben Hsu: keep this high touch; risk looks time-sensitive.
Leah Ortiz: will update after PM reply. (reaction :eyes: 4202468345)
